# Nature skills attribution

Source repository: https://github.com/Yuan1z0825/nature-skills
Verified commit: `473e8d7b1b918fe37208d3a5e143a3ac9af4c91b`
License: Apache License 2.0

The project examined the Nature skills work for general ideas about
evidence-matched scientific claims, paragraph function, statistical meaning,
and placing supporting detail according to its relevance. Research Without
Theater reauthored one smaller, independent skill around those ideas.

No text, code, skill routing, scripts, Guard components, hooks, or runtime
files from the Nature repository are copied into this product. No Nature skill
is loaded or called at run time.

The local installation of the Nature skills may contain local edits. The fixed
commit above is the remote source point used for this attribution record, not a
claim that an installed copy is byte-identical to it.

The complete Apache License 2.0 text is in [LICENSE](LICENSE). No upstream
`NOTICE` file was found in the files examined for the fixed source point; this
record states the actual conceptual relationship.
